title: Battelle studied Roswell lightweight metals

tellings.quote: and there there's research to suggest that Battel also studied the like really lightweight metals out of the 1947 Roswell crash.

plain: The Battelle Memorial Institute, a private research institute, studied very lightweight metals taken from the reported 1947 crash of a flying saucer near Roswell, New Mexico. That is the claim of a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb, who says "there's research to suggest" it and points to papers he calls Project Stork. If true, a civilian lab would have handled crash material in the years right after Roswell.
